fact: GasyNet reports in June 2025 that the TradeNet electronic single window, with the Douar customs module and the Midac module for ministries and control agencies, is in service and average clearance time is three days.
title: COMMERCE EXTÉRIEUR – GasyNet rapporte un délai moyen de dédouanement réduit à trois jours grâce au guichet unique électronique TradeNet
